maddeler.e:
ننهمك (form VII)
# نَنْهَمِكُ (nanhamiku) /nan.ha.mi.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# نَنْهَمِكَ (nanhamika) /nan.ha.mi.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
# نَنْهَمِكْ (nanhamik) /nan.ha.mik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَكَ (inhamaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
